name: cutaway
description: cutaway by Nyxera0x, wrapped by FrameCore Works: one reference picture of a robotic animal, machine or device rebuilt as a three.js object in code that takes itself apart part by part, filmed at 60 fps with a synced procedural score. Optional reference images through your own image connector, optional local Kokoro narrator. Works best with Claude Opus 5.5. Checkout pinned to the reviewed commit.

interface.longDescription: Turn one picture of a robotic animal, machine or device into a three.js object that takes itself apart on camera, with a page of part buttons and a 60 fps film with a procedural score, using cutaway by Nyxera0x (MIT). Downloads the repository at the reviewed commit into the project after your yes; needs git, Node.js 20+, ffmpeg, Python 3 and Chrome or Chromium. Reference images can come from your own image connector; a local Kokoro narrator is optional and asked separately. Works best with Claude Opus 5.5.
